name: Cunning of Atherann adds 25% of Stamina and Spirit to spell damage (#764)
contract: Cunning of Atherann 706599 carries two SPELL_AURA_MOD_SPELL_DAMAGE_OF_STAT_PERCENT (aura 174) effects, BasePoints 24 (real +25%, EffectDieSides=1), MiscValue 126 (all magic schools), MiscValueB Stamina(2) on effect 0 and Spirit(4) on effect 1 (confirmed via the installed Spell.dbc). AuraEffect::HandleModSpellDamagePercentFromStat (SpellAuraEffects.cpp) is consumed generically by Unit::SpellBaseDamageBonusDone (Unit.cpp:9508-9517). This is a passive-flagged spell, so learning auto-applies the self-aura, and aura_amount reads its live percentage directly. A spell_damage_done probe was tried first (Frostbolt, Bloodbolt, Vampiric Fang, Keleseth's Calamity, Valanar's Vengeance, Atherann's Anguish): every one of them returned the unmodified 1000 baseline in this harness, because Unit::SpellDamageBonusDone only adds the stat-bonus term when the target spell's own damage coefficient (spell_bonus_data or the effect's BonusMultiplier, Unit.cpp:9284) is nonzero, and that coefficient is zero/unpopulated for every spell probed on this harness's isolated world data - a harness data limitation, not a Cunning of Atherann defect. aura_amount is used instead to assert the tooltip's exact 25%/25% values directly.
